modules.name: FPS
modules.description: Shows your frames per second.

modules.name: CPS
modules.description: Shows your clicks per second.

modules.name: Keystrokes
modules.description: Shows the movement keys and mouse buttons you press.

modules.name: Coordinates
modules.description: Shows your position, facing and biome.

modules.name: Direction HUD
modules.description: A compass strip showing which way you face.

modules.name: Armor Status
modules.description: Shows your armor and held item with durability.

modules.name: Potion Effects
modules.description: Lists active potion effects with their time left.

modules.name: Ping
modules.description: Shows your latency to the server.

modules.name: Memory Usage
modules.description: Shows how much of its memory the game is using.

modules.name: Clock
modules.description: Shows the real-world time.

modules.name: Saturation
modules.description: Shows your hidden hunger saturation.

modules.name: Item Counter
modules.description: Counts key PvP items in your inventory, plus totems and crystals on modern versions.

modules.name: Toggle Sprint
modules.description: Press your sprint key once to keep sprinting. Optionally toggles sneak too.

modules.name: Zoom
modules.description: Hold C (changeable in Controls) to zoom. Scroll to adjust.

modules.name: Fullbright
modules.description: Maxes out brightness so caves and nights are fully lit.

modules.name: Crosshair
modules.description: A custom crosshair.

modules.name: Lobby Player Hider
modules.description: Hides other player models only in crowded lobbies identified by the server scoreboard. Tab list and server interactions stay unchanged.

modules.name: Entity Culling
modules.description: Culls distant entities and block entities. Choose how aggressively render distance limits are applied; player culling is controlled separately.

modules.name: Particle Limiter
modules.description: Caps how many particles exist at once and skips far-away ones, avoiding frame drops in fights.

modules.name: Unfocused FPS Limit
modules.description: Lowers the frame rate while the game is in the background, saving power and heat.

modules.name: Performance Tweaks
modules.description: Uncapped frame rate and faster rendering options vanilla leaves off.

modules.name: Sodium Renderer
modules.description: Novo Client's port of Sodium's chunk renderer: compact vertices in shared region buffers, one draw per region instead of one per chunk. Needs OpenGL 3.3 and VBOs.

modules.name: Fast Math
modules.description: Smaller, cache-friendly sine and cosine tables. Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Smart Animations
modules.description: Only animates water, lava and other block textures that are on screen. Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Lazy Chunk Loading
modules.description: Singleplayer loads chunks over more ticks, for fewer stutters. Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Connected Textures
modules.description: Seamless glass out of the box, plus connected textures (CTM) from resource packs. Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Custom Sky
modules.description: Shows skyboxes from resource packs (OptiFine / MCPatcher sky format). Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Better Grass
modules.description: Grass and mycelium cover the sides of blocks. Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Better Snow
modules.description: Snow fills in around plants, fences and walls. Inspired by OptiFine; Novo Client's own code.

modules.name: Auto Mode Profiles
modules.description: Detects what you're playing and keeps a separate setup for each mode: HUD layout, mods, their settings and your keybinds. 1.8.9: Sword, Pot, UHC, Bed Wars, SkyWars, The Bridge. 26.3: Crystal, Mace, Spear, Axe, Sword, NethPot, UHC.

settings.label: Show a notice when the profile switches

modules.name: Custom Menus
modules.description: Novo Client's own Options screen, and every other menu (servers, worlds, controls, dialogs) restyled to match Novo Client.

modules.name: Video Settings
modules.description: Novo Client's Video Settings screen: vanilla options plus Sodium and the rendering features in one place.

modules.name: Patcher Fixes
modules.description: Fixes for 1.8.9: borderless fullscreen on F11, camera parallax, inventory shifting with potions.

settings.label: Don't shift the inventory for potion effects

modules.name: 1.7 Visuals
modules.description: Classic 1.7 feel: swing while blocking, eating or drawing a bow, and armor that flashes red when hit.

modules.name: Hit Color
modules.description: Changes the tint entities flash when they take damage.

modules.name: Block Outline
modules.description: A custom outline (and optional fill) on the block you look at.

modules.name: Hurt Cam
modules.description: Reduces or removes the camera shake when you take damage.

modules.name: FOV Changer
modules.description: Stops sprinting and speed effects from changing your field of view.

settings.label: No FOV change from sprint and speed

modules.name: Particle Changer
modules.description: More hit particles: multiply crits and sharpness, or always show them.

modules.name: Time Changer
modules.description: Shows the world at a fixed time of day (only for you).

modules.name: Weather Changer
modules.description: Shows clear skies, rain or a storm (only for you).

modules.name: Fog Customizer
modules.description: Removes render-distance fog and can recolor it.

modules.name: Glint Colorizer
modules.description: Recolors the enchantment glint on items and armor.

modules.name: Motion Blur
modules.description: Smooth trails when you move the camera.

modules.name: Menu Blur
modules.description: Blurs the world behind inventories and menus.

modules.name: Modern Font
modules.description: Uses the clean Poppins font in Novo Client menus and the HUD instead of the pixel font.

modules.name: Loading Screen
modules.description: Novo Client fades in with a spinning loading ring while you connect to servers and load worlds.

modules.name: Dynamic Lights
modules.description: Held torches and other glowing items light up the world around you, like OptiFine.

settings.label: Burning mobs, blazes and fireballs glow

modules.name: 2D Items
modules.description: Dropped items render as flat sprites that face you.

modules.name: Item Physics
modules.description: Dropped items lie flat on the ground and tumble as they fall.

modules.name: Hitbox
modules.description: Shows entity hitboxes (like F3+B) with your own color.

modules.name: Chunk Borders
modules.description: Draws the borders of the chunks around you.

modules.name: Nametags
modules.description: Nametag tweaks: your own nametag in F5 and background opacity.

settings.label: Show your own nametag in F5

modules.name: Novo Client Badge
modules.description: The Novo Client logo next to the names of other Novo Client players, on nametags and in the tab list.

settings.label: Let other Novo Client players see your badge and cape

modules.name: Novo Capes
modules.description: Capes from Novo accounts. Pick yours in the launcher's Accounts page; other Novo Client players see it while you're online.

modules.name: Freelook
modules.description: Hold Left Alt (changeable in Controls) to look around without turning.

settings.label: Switch to third person while held

modules.name: Snaplook
modules.description: Hold a key to look behind you. Bind it in Controls > Novo Client.

modules.name: Novo Client Menu
modules.description: The Novo Client main menu instead of the vanilla one.

modules.name: Combo Counter
modules.description: Counts hits in a row without getting hit back.

modules.name: Reach Display
modules.description: Shows how far away your last hit landed.

modules.name: Scoreboard
modules.description: Movable sidebar scoreboard; hide the red numbers and set the background.

modules.name: Boss Bar
modules.description: Movable, resizable boss health bar.

modules.name: Titles
modules.description: Shrinks or hides the big title and subtitle text servers show.

modules.name: Chat
modules.description: Timestamps and stacking of repeated messages ("(x3)").

modules.name: Tab Editor
modules.description: Player list tweaks: ping as numbers, background, header and footer.

modules.name: Nick Hider
modules.description: Shows a different name wherever your own name appears on your screen (chat, tab, nametags). Only you see it.

modules.name: Scrollable Tooltips
modules.description: Scroll long item tooltips with the mouse wheel in inventories.

modules.name: TNT Countdown
modules.description: Shows the seconds left above lit TNT.

modules.name: Cooldowns
modules.description: Countdowns after throwing an ender pearl or eating a golden apple (set to the server's cooldown).

modules.name: Stopwatch
modules.description: Press the stopwatch key (set it in Controls) to start or stop; Shift + key resets.

modules.name: Server Address
modules.description: Shows the address of the server you are on.

modules.name: Pack Display
modules.description: Lists your active resource packs.

modules.name: Playtime
modules.description: How long you have been in the current world or server.

modules.name: Day Counter
modules.description: Which in-game day it is.

modules.name: Auto GG
modules.description: Says gg in chat when a match ends (Hypixel, PvP Land and more).

modules.name: Auto Text
modules.description: Send chat messages or commands with a key. Bind Auto Text 1-3 in Controls.

modules.name: Hypixel Tools
modules.description: Requeue, hide lobby and Watchdog spam, game alerts and quick reports. Bind Requeue and Report Player in Controls; /qr <player>.

settings.label: Sound when a game starts or ends (window in background)

modules.name: Quickplay
modules.description: Press J to join any Hypixel game or lobby in one click.

modules.name: Hit Sounds
modules.description: Plays a sound when you hit a player or mob, and another on a kill.

modules.name: Low Health Warning
modules.description: Pulses a red glow around the screen when your health is low.

modules.name: Waypoints
modules.description: Press B to mark a spot and M to list them. Beams and distances show through walls.

modules.name: Screenshot Manager
modules.description: Open, copy or delete screenshots right from chat, plus a gallery in the Esc menu.

modules.name: Mod List
modules.description: An ArrayList-style list of your active mods down the screen edge, in a moving rainbow or Novo Client gradient.

modules.name: Attack Cooldown
modules.description: A charge bar under the crosshair that lights up at full charge, and shows when your next hit will crit.

modules.name: Totem Pop Counter
modules.description: Counts each player's totem pops: in chat and next to their nametag.

modules.name: Target HUD
modules.description: The player you're fighting: head, health, armor and distance.

modules.name: Armor Durability Alert
modules.description: Warns when a piece of your armor or your elytra is about to break.

modules.name: Mace / Elytra HUD
modules.description: Fall distance and smash damage with a mace; speed, height, fireworks and durability while flying.
